definitions.explanation: A system of government in which a single ruler or small group holds absolute power without constitutional or democratic constraints. Used in historical, political, and academic contexts.

examples.japanese: {専制政治|せんせいせいじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧。
examples.english: Autocratic rule robs the people of their freedom.

examples.japanese: ⟦フランス→フランス：19418_furansu⟧⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専制政治|せんせいせいじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{民衆|みんしゅう}→民衆：13259_minshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反乱|はんらん}→反乱：11860_hanran⟧だった。
examples.english: The French Revolution was a popular uprising against despotic rule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いまだ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専制政治|せんせいせいじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、{国際社会|こくさいしゃかい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: There are still countries where autocratic rule continues, drawing criticism from the international community.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{専制|せんせい}→専制：17739_sensei⟧ (autocracy, despotism) and ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧ (politics, government). The ⟦{専制|せんせい}→専制：17739_sensei⟧ component means exclusive or monopolistic control. A standard term in history textbooks and political science.

USAGE:
Commonly encountered in world history education when discussing absolute monarchies, dictatorships, and pre-modern political systems. Also used in contemporary commentary about authoritarian regimes. More formal and academic than simply calling a government ⟦{独裁|どくさい}→独裁：05969_dokusai⟧ (dictatorship).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専制政治|せんせいせいじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out autocratic rule
- {専制政治|せんせいせいじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打倒|だとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to overthrow despotic rule
- {専制政治|せんせいせいじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: the era of autocratic rule
- {専制政治|せんせいせいじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧: to suffer under despotism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {独裁政治|どくさいせいじ}: dictatorship — emphasizes rule by a single dictator; more modern and direct
- ⟦{専制|せんせい}→専制：17739_sensei⟧: autocracy, despotism — the shorter form, usable on its own as a noun
- {絶対王政|ぜったいおうせい}: absolute monarchy — specifically refers to monarchical despotism, as in pre-revolutionary France
- {民主政治|みんしゅせいじ}: democratic government — the opposite concept
